label: Nothing can be without itself
paraphrase: OPEN meaning-postulate candidate, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for no x can x be while x is not, that is, CanBeWithout x x fails for every x. CanBeWithout is the primitive of DEF-CAN-BE-WITHOUT ('y can be while x is not', 'possunt' read as real possibility). On that gloss CanBeWithout x x asks for a possible situation in which x both is and is not, so the postulate is the diagonal instance of non-contradiction under the definition's reading; the Lean primitive does not build it in, so it is registered as an explicit statement. It says nothing about dependence for being. With STMT-INDEPENDENCE-ALLOWS-BEING-WITHOUT (8ab3d114) it forces every being to depend for its being on itself (not-not D(x,x), constructively); that consequence is what makes the self-dependence package of #1751 inconsistent.
